description: Inspired by Terry Pratchett's Discworld, 'Octarine' is the mythical eighth color visible only to wizards, witches, cats—and those who've stared at iptables rules too long. A swamp dragon perches atop the Unseen University gazing at 64 stars (one for each KEP). Sidecar containers graduate to GA, in-place resize moves to beta, and as Pratchett wrote: 'It's still magic even if you know how it's done.'
